text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Public security in Budapest has been improving since new leaders were appointed to the Budapest police force, Minister of Interior Gabor Kuncze said.
- Hungary's border crossings are no longer congested after a weekend wave of guest workers from Germany has passed.
- Hungary has sent another batch of aid to flood-stricken Poland.
- The Minister of Interior will shortly receive an austerity programme, including outsourcing measures, for the national police.
- Social injustice will be on the agenda of the Protestant World Congress to be held from Friday in the town of Debrecen, east Hungary.
